query:
UPDATE oauth_oidc_payloads
            SET payload = jsonb_set(
                jsonb_set(payload, '{revoked}', 'true'::jsonb),
                '{revokedAt}', to_jsonb($4::text)
            ),
            consumed_at = $3
            WHERE type = $1
              AND grant_id = $2
              AND (payload->>'revoked' IS NULL OR payload->>'revoked' = 'false')
